ui.tagline: Stage a miracle. Make it real.
ui.level_unavailable: The stage could not be opened

level.L01.title: A Stone With Ambition
level.L01.intro: Felix promised a floating stone. Marfa has already sold the tickets. Start with a float and a convincing show.
level.L01.joke: Felix checks for a second support. There isn't one.
level.L01.success: The stone holds itself up. Your first crossing works!
level.L01.hint1: Let them see the stone, while its support stays hidden.
level.L01.hint2: Block the lower mechanism point without hiding the result.
level.L01.hint3: Set the stone on the float and the screen on the left. Perform, seal, then remove the float.
level.L02.title: Front Row, Wrong View
level.L02.objective: Give three spectators a clear view and deliver the crate.
level.L02.intro: The ticket booth has the best seat. Help a spectator see the show, then deliver the parcel.
level.L02.joke: Marfa: 'A front-row ticket is no guarantee of a first-class view.'
level.L02.success: The parcel arrived. The side row had a fine view.
level.L02.hint1: One spectator can only see the ticket booth.
level.L02.hint3: Move the spectator from behind the booth to the empty seat on the right, then perform again.
level.L03.title: How About the Back?
level.L03.objective: Pass both inspections and deliver the parcel.
level.L03.intro: Semyon checks the back as well. He was polite enough to announce his route.
level.L03.joke: Semyon: 'Convincing from the front. I will inspect the rest of the convincing.'
level.L03.success: The parcel arrived and both inspections are complete.
level.L03.hint1: Semyon will inspect more than the front.
level.L03.hint2: Check his second stop and the ray to the float.
level.L03.hint3: Place the second screen on the right side of the stage to hide the float from the second view.
level.L04.title: Wind Has Opinions
level.L04.objective: Secure the screen, prove the miracle and cross.
level.L04.intro: The wind bought no ticket, but insists on participating. Secure the props before the show.
level.L04.joke: Plum opens a tiny umbrella. The wind closes it for him.
level.L04.success: The wind lost its part. Felix reached the bank.
level.L04.hint1: The weather vane explains the movement.
level.L04.hint3: Attach both clamps, or secure the screen with the sandbag in the sheltered slot.
level.L05.title: The Anchor Gets Promoted
level.L05.objective: Keep the boat moored and unload.
level.L05.intro: The anchor decided to float. The boat needs a new mooring and an ordinary wooden bollard.
level.L05.joke: Marfa: 'The anchor became a float. A promotion, apparently.'
level.L05.success: The boat is secure and its cargo is unloaded.
level.L05.hint1: The stone law affects the anchor too.
level.L05.hint3: Tie the boat to the wooden bollard before unloading.
level.L06.title: Almost an Ark
level.L06.objective: Bring the goat and both crates to the far shore.
level.L06.intro: Caramel weighs two units; the small support carries one. Plan separate trips for the goat and crates.
level.L06.joke: Caramel tries to eat the ticket. The ticket is wooden. The ticket wins.
level.L06.success: The goat and both crates arrived without overloading.
level.L06.hint1: The goat weighs more than one crate.
level.L06.hint2: The small stone carries one extra unit.
level.L06.hint3: Send the goat across on the medium stone separately, then tow each crate.
level.L07.title: A River Too Wide
level.L07.objective: Reach the far dock using the island.
level.L07.intro: Your bridge is too short for the river. The dry island lets you reposition a support for the next part.
level.L07.joke: Felix: 'A short bridge. Fortunately, it knows how to continue.'
level.L07.success: The short bridge carried Felix across the entire river.
level.L07.hint1: The island is a safe stopping point.
level.L07.hint2: A support behind you can help with the next part.
level.L07.hint3: Reach the island, then move the released near stone to the reachable far slot.
level.L08.title: Exactly Two Secrets
level.L08.objective: Remove both supports and complete the crossing.
level.L08.intro: The stone has two secrets. Hide the float, then remember the visible safety thread.
level.L08.joke: Nika: 'They found one secret. Good thing you packed a spare.'
level.L08.success: Both hidden supports are gone. A real miracle remains.
level.L08.hint1: The warning points to another mechanism.
level.L08.hint3: Remove the safety thread before the show, or hide it behind a separate screen.
level.L09.title: After the Applause
level.L09.objective: Earn three valid votes and deliver the crate.
level.L09.intro: Two people are ready to clap. Semyon is still walking to his last inspection stop.
level.L09.joke: Roza's note: 'Applause is not a measuring instrument.'
level.L09.success: The last vote is in and the load has arrived.
level.L09.hint1: The last vote has not arrived yet.
level.L09.hint3: Cover the side mechanism and wait for the full inspection.
level.L10.title: A Ferry on Good Faith
level.L10.objective: Bring every passenger and the cargo across while the boat stays moored.
level.L10.intro: The festive crossing is almost ready. Secure the boat and send the goat and cargo in safe separate trips.
level.L10.joke: Marfa lists Felix as 'temporarily permanent miracle'.
level.L10.success: The festive crossing is open. Passengers and boat are safe.
level.L10.hint1: A floating anchor cannot be the only mooring.
level.L10.hint2: Prepare the route and secure the boat before sealing.
level.L10.hint3: Use the wooden bollard, prove the miracle, then transport the heavy loads separately.
level.L11.title: The Flame Takes a Break
level.L11.objective: Prove the freezing transition and cross the ice.
level.L11.intro: Lada would like a cooling fire. A stage flame and a real cold pack can show the right transformation.
level.L11.joke: Lada: 'Our fire has lost its professional warmth.'
level.L11.success: Lada has cold fire and a usable ice passage.
level.L11.hint1: The water must change during the show.
level.L11.hint2: The flame and water must remain visible.
level.L11.hint3: Start with liquid water and place the hidden cold pack beneath the bowl.
level.L12.title: Pastries With Personality
level.L12.objective: Freeze dessert, protect bread and deliver both.
level.L12.intro: The dessert needs cold. The bread needs a closed insulated box. Prepare both before loading.
level.L12.joke: Lada relabels an unsuccessful pie as 'festive sorbet'.
level.L12.success: Bread preserved, dessert frozen, delivery complete.
level.L12.hint2: A closed insulated box blocks the cold.
level.L12.hint3: Protect the bread, freeze the dessert, then load both into the delivery crate.
level.L13.title: Two Stoves, One Boat
level.L13.objective: Freeze the walking passage and keep boat water liquid.
level.L13.intro: The law changes both ovens. Protect the boat channel separately: boats do not sail on ice.
level.L13.joke: Semyon: 'The law is universal. The partitions are local.'
level.L13.success: People have ice to walk on; the boat still has liquid water.
level.L13.hint1: Both zones freeze for the same reason.
level.L13.hint2: The law affects every real fire.
level.L13.hint3: Block the thermal path to the boat, or move the nearby oven away.
level.L14.title: Cold Under Scrutiny
level.L14.objective: Earn the inspector vote and open the cold passage.
level.L14.intro: Semyon will inspect from two sides. Keep the water surface visible while hiding the cold pack.
level.L14.success: Semyon accepted the proof. The cold passage is ready.
level.L14.hint1: Hiding the whole bowl also hides the result.
level.L14.hint2: Check the water surface and cold pack separately.
level.L14.hint3: Cover the pack from both inspection stops while leaving the surface visible.
level.L15.title: Not All Heat Is Fire
level.L15.objective: Thaw the bowl while keeping the ice crossing.
level.L15.intro: The stone stays warm even while fire turns cold. A heated object has a different thermal class.
level.L15.joke: Lada: 'The stone missed the announcement for fire.'
level.L15.success: The bowl thawed while the main ice remained.
level.L15.hint2: A heated stone keeps its thermal class.
level.L15.hint3: Screen off the cold fire and warm the bowl with the heated stone.
level.L16.title: A Steamy Secret
level.L16.objective: Seal before the steam disperses and open the route.
level.L16.intro: Steam can hide the mechanism briefly. Seal the miracle before the secret evaporates.
level.L16.joke: Felix: 'The secret evaporated. The result stayed.'
level.L16.success: The steam is gone. The real law remains.
level.L16.hint1: Steam only needs to last until sealing.
level.L16.hint2: Allow a full continuous observation interval.
level.L16.hint3: Hide only the mechanism ray with steam, or use a permanent screen.
level.L17.title: A Second Seal
level.L17.objective: Keep both laws and pass both sections.
level.L17.intro: A second space has opened in the album. Keep floating stones and add freezing fire.
level.L17.joke: Roza asks: 'One impossibility was no longer sufficient?'
level.L17.success: Both miracles work together. The route is complete.
level.L17.hint1: The second law fits in the empty slot.
level.L17.hint3: Seal the cold-fire law in the free slot, then run the whole route.
level.L18.title: Boats Prefer Liquid
level.L18.objective: Free the boat and keep the pedestrian support.
level.L18.intro: The boat is stuck in very reliable water. Remove local cooling and add independent heat.
level.L18.joke: Marfa: 'Very reliable water. Absolutely refuses to sail.'
level.L18.success: The boat sails again and the pedestrian support remains.
level.L18.hint1: The boat needs liquid water in its own zone.
level.L18.hint2: Stop the cooling and add independent heat.
level.L18.hint3: Put the screen between the oven and the boat, then bring the heated stone closer.
level.L19.title: Give Fire Its Job Back
level.L19.objective: Restore ordinary heat and keep the crossing.
level.L19.intro: The kitchen needs ordinary heat again. Prepare a stone support before the ice can thaw.
level.L19.joke: Lada: 'Firing the fire was a heated decision. Well, the opposite.'
level.L19.success: The oven warms again. The stone crossing still works.
level.L19.hint1: Ordinary fire will thaw the ice.
level.L19.hint2: Prepare a support that does not depend on ice.
level.L19.hint3: Build the stone crossing before revoking the cold-fire law.
level.L20.title: The Backwards Feast
level.L20.intro: Two dishes have different temperature preferences. Protect the bread, chill the dessert and deliver both.
level.L20.joke: Lada's menu: 'Miracles served with a side dish.'
level.L20.success: The feast arrived with both dishes preserved.
level.L20.hint1: The feast needs two different temperature results.
level.L20.hint2: Source positions and insulation remain your choices.
level.L20.hint3: Protect the bread, freeze the dessert before loading, then deliver both across the stone support.
level.L21.title: A Sheet With Backbone
level.L21.objective: Remove the frame and carry the load over paper with two anchors.
level.L21.intro: The hidden frame currently carries the heavy load. Show paper holding it, then remove the frame after sealing.
level.L21.joke: Felix: 'It works on paper. For once, literally.'
level.L21.success: The frame is gone. The paper span carried the load.
level.L21.hint1: The paper must actually carry the weight.
level.L21.hint2: The frame is the method; contact with the weight is the result.
level.L21.hint3: Mount the paper at both anchors, screen the frame and use the hoist to lower the test load onto the paper.
level.L22.title: Not for Goats
level.L22.objective: Lead the goat to its food and preserve the paper.
level.L22.intro: Caramel usually solves paper problems with her teeth. The wooden gate has an excellent ordinary handle.
level.L22.joke: Caramel studies the sheet, then takes the respectful detour.
level.L22.success: The goat reached its food and the document survived.
level.L22.hint1: Strong paper makes a strong barrier too.
level.L22.hint2: The gate has another material and an ordinary handle.
level.L22.hint3: Open the wooden gate and choose the detour.
level.L23.title: The Fiery Archive
level.L23.intro: Paper is strong but still flammable. Change the fire or block its thermal path.
level.L23.joke: Roza: 'Steel does not recommend standing in an oven either.'
level.L23.success: The document arrived without burning the paper.
level.L23.hint1: Strength does not make paper fireproof.
level.L23.hint2: Change the fire or block its thermal path.
level.L23.hint3: Add the cold-fire law, or put the screen between the oven and paper.
level.L24.title: A Lightweight Solution
level.L24.objective: Deliver without overloading the floating supports.
level.L24.intro: The light span rests on floating foundations. Paper strength does not remove the stones’ load limit.
level.L24.success: The load arrived, shared between both foundations.
level.L24.hint1: Paper strength and floating capacity are separate limits.
level.L24.hint3: Attach the span to both medium stones, remove the heavy test weight and check the final combined load.
level.L25.title: The Other Side of Approval
level.L25.objective: Earn Roza approval and move the load over the span.
level.L25.intro: Roza brought a folder and two viewing angles. Keep the paper and its load visible from both.
level.L25.joke: Roza: 'I am checking the reverse side of your approval.'
level.L25.success: Roza approved the structure and the load crossed.
level.L25.hint1: The poster can hide too much of the result.
level.L25.hint2: Separate the ray to the frame from the ray to the weight.
level.L25.hint3: Cover the frame from both sides, keeping the paper and weight visible.
level.L26.title: Two Slots, Three Miracles
level.L26.objective: Finish with at most two active laws.
level.L26.intro: A third miracle needs room. Finish the dry-land delivery before preparing the replacement.
level.L26.joke: Felix: 'May I have a third miracle?' Roza: 'Certainly. In place of one of the other two.'
level.L26.success: The third miracle found its place in time. Every goal is complete.
level.L26.hint1: A new law does not replace an old one automatically.
level.L26.hint2: Prepare for whichever law you remove.
level.L26.hint3: Finish the water delivery before replacing the stone law, or shield the fire before replacing the cold-fire law.
level.L27.title: Still Paper
level.L27.objective: Deliver while preserving the canopy and flags.
level.L27.intro: Strong paper still dislikes heat. Move the oven or screen its thermal path.
level.L27.joke: Lada: 'The paper became stronger. Keep the same caution.'
level.L27.success: Canopy and flags preserved; delivery complete.
level.L27.hint1: A new miracle is optional here.
level.L27.hint2: Moving the oven changes where its heat reaches.
level.L27.hint3: Move the oven to the far slot, or screen off its thermal path.
level.L28.title: A Certificate of Impossibility
level.L28.objective: Prove paper strength independently and deliver the test load.
level.L28.intro: Roza already accepts floating stones. This time she needs separate proof of paper holding a load.
level.L28.joke: Roza: 'Your impossible is in the ordinary register.'
level.L28.success: The separate proof was accepted and the test load arrived.
level.L28.hint1: Applause for the existing stone law does not prove paper strength.
level.L28.hint2: The new result is the weight resting on paper.
level.L28.hint3: Bring the stone support from the water to its dry mounting point, then stage the separate paper test.
level.L29.title: The Rival's Miracle
level.L29.objective: Show water freezing during the performance and finish together.
level.L29.intro: Hugo prepared a beautiful lump of ice. Help him show the transformation itself, beginning with liquid water.
level.L29.joke: Hugo: 'It was a prepared miracle.' Nika: 'It also needs to happen.'
level.L29.success: The audience saw liquid water actually become ice.
level.L29.hint2: The demonstration must begin with liquid water.
level.L29.hint3: Thaw the old sample with the heated stone first, then stage the freezing transition.
level.L30.title: The Square of Possibilities
level.L30.objective: Deliver to dry land, keep the paper intact and reach the finale.
level.L30.intro: Three miracles meet in one square. Deliver to dry land, open the cold passage and make room for strong paper.
level.L30.joke: Felix removes the last thread. Plum takes it for his scarf.
level.L30.success: Cargo is on dry land and the paper crossing is complete. The square comes alive.
level.L30.hint1: Three laws need not be active at once.
level.L30.hint2: Cargo delivered to dry land no longer needs to float.
level.L30.hint3: Deliver first, freeze the passage, then replace the stone law with paper strength and complete the final crossing.

ui.credits_text:
Felix, Plum, Marfa, Semyon, Nika, Lada, Roza, Hugo and Caramel thank you.

This world now knows that even the impossible begins with a well-planned trick.

Music and illustrations were created for this game.

reason.GENERIC: This action is unavailable. Check the plan or undo.
